messages.subject: Error: /v1/applications/ 400 - Bad Request
parts:
Hi,

I am trying to deploy my app, but getting following error.

deployApp()
Preparing to deploy application...
Error: /v1/applications/ 400 - Bad Request

My App is working fine locally. Here is my code https://github.com/praneethj13/App-Survey

Thanks
Praneeth

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Error: /v1/applications/ 400 - Bad Request
parts:
Hi,

The issue is probably with the name of your application. The application name defaults to the name of the directory where the application is (the current working directory).

Application names must be at least 3 characters and may not container spaces. 

You can try renaming the directory, or calling deployApp(appName="your_app_name").

-Andy
